name: ppt-vector-export
description: Export one-slide PowerPoint figures to vector-preserving PDF and SVG.

interface.shortDescription: Export PowerPoint diagrams to vector PDF and SVG
interface.longDescription: Preserve native PowerPoint shapes and arrowheads, restore embedded SVG artwork when export rasterizes it, and verify the resulting PDF and SVG.
defaultPrompt: Export my PowerPoint figure as vector PDF and SVG.
Check whether this PPTX export rasterized its embedded SVG artwork.
